strings.name: Peter Jackson
strings.summary: Jackson began with low-budget horror comedy and moved through Heavenly Creatures into international production. He directed The Lord of the Rings and The Hobbit and developed New Zealand’s effects network with longtime collaborators. The Return of the King earned directing and shared producing and writing Oscars. Later documentaries explored archival restoration. Cannes awarded him an honorary Palme in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: By directing The Lord of the Rings, he advanced New Zealand’s film industry, digital-effects production and the worldwide circulation of fantasy imagery.
